meta.name: browser
meta.description: Drives a real browser through the omowright library from the js eval kernel: sites the user is already signed into, forms and clicks, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, web QA, extension popups, a human handoff for login, CAPTCHA or OTP, and a browser you own for scraping, bot-scored targets, network capture and QA traces. Use for any interactive browser task; not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作真实浏览器,完成点击、填表、截图与页面检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要让程序替你在真实网站上点击、填表或采集数据。
copy.tagline_en: Automate a real browser to click, fill forms, and capture screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need a program to click, fill forms, or scrape real websites.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能驱动一个真实浏览器:在你自己已登录的浏览器里点击、填表、截图、读取 JS 渲染页面;需要登录、验证码或 OTP 时它会暂停并请你接手。
howto.when: 当任务需要在浏览器里交互时接管,比如已登录站点上的点击与填表、截图等;单纯的搜索或未被拦截的静态抓取不归它管。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com 并截个图
say.note: 它会先导航再返回截图

say.text: 在搜索框填上「browser」然后按回车
帮我登录这个网站,遇到验证码就叫我
say.note: 它会暂停并请你手动完成

howto.what_en: Claude drives a real browser through the omowright library: clicks, form filling, screenshots and JS-rendered pages, using either the user's own signed-in browser or one it launches itself.
howto.when_en: Use for any interactive browser task: sites the user is already signed into, forms and clicks, screenshots or JS-rendered pages. Not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: It navigates first, then returns a screenshot

say_en.text: Type "browser" into the search box and press Enter
say_en.note: It fills the field and submits

say_en.text: Log me into this site; ask me for the CAPTCHA
say_en.note: It pauses and hands off to you
